title: Earthquakes
text:
An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground. It happens when large pieces of rock under the Earth move. Most earthquakes are small, but some are very strong. In a strong earthquake, buildings can fall down.

People in earthquake areas can prepare for danger. They keep water, food, and a torch in a safe place. When the ground starts to shake, they should stand under a strong table. After the shaking stops, they should leave the building carefully.

questions.text: What happens when large pieces of rock under the Earth move?
What should people keep in a safe place?
Why do people in earthquake areas keep water and food ready?
options: They want to be ready if a disaster happens.
They want to sell them to shops.
They like to go camping every day.
They do not like to eat at home.

questions.text: What can you conclude about strong earthquakes?
options: They can damage buildings and hurt people.
They always last for a whole week.
They happen only under the sea.

vocabulary.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground caused by moving rock under the Earth
moving quickly from side to side or up and down
to get ready for something that is going to happen
a small light that you carry in your hand

paragraph_translations: Землетрус — це раптова тряска землі. Він відбувається, коли великі шматки породи під Землею рухаються. Більшість землетрусів слабкі, але деякі дуже сильні. Під час сильного землетрусу будинки можуть обвалитися.

Люди в районах землетрусів можуть підготуватися до небезпеки. Вони тримають воду, їжу та ліхтарик у безпечному місці. Коли земля починає трястися, вони мають стати під міцний стіл. Після того як тряска припиняється, вони обережно виходять із будівлі.
